name: Hackathon  (24 hours)
description: Collaborative coding marathon to build innovative solutions.
event_directives: Teams of 2-4; all members must be registered.
Problem statement is revealed only at the start.
Libraries are allowed; pre-built projects are not.
Judging is based on innovation, functionality, and pitch.
Submit a working demo with a short final pitch.

name: Treasure Hunt
description: Solve clues and puzzles to find hidden treasures.
event_directives: Team size is exactly 4 participants.
All clues are logic-based.
Check in at every clue point; no skipping.
No communication with other teams during the event.
First team to reach the final location wins.

name: Mini Militia
event_directives: Solo tournament with 3 rounds: Qualifier, Semi-Final, and Final.
All matches are solo deathmatch with a 15-minute limit per round.
Top 3 players advance to the final; ranking uses kills and survival tie-break.
No hacked/mod apps, cheating, or abusive language; violations mean disqualification.
No restarts for personal technical issues; organizer decision is final.

name: Trouble Shooting
description: Identify and fix technical issues under time pressure.
event_directives: Individual event; all participants get the same fault scenarios.
Timer starts at seat-in and stops when you declare completion.
Partial fixes earn partial marks; scoring favors accuracy and speed.
Only C/C++ challenges are allowed in all rounds.
No phones or external help; cheating leads to disqualification.

name: Typing
description: Speed typing competition to test accuracy and pace.
event_directives: Use only the provided standard lab membrane keyboards.
No macros, auto-typing scripts, or platform tampering.
Any cheating attempt results in instant disqualification.
If WPM ties, higher overall accuracy wins.
Platform results and coordinator decisions are final.

name: IT Quiz
description: Quiz competition on IT knowledge and current trends.
event_directives: No phones or smartwatches during stage rounds.
Hand-raising is strictly enforced for answering.
Stage spotters make the final call on fastest hand.
Audience shout-outs void the question immediately.
Quizmaster decisions are final in all disputes.

name: Logo Designing
description: Creative contest to design impactful logos.
event_directives: Individual participation only.
Design must be original and non-plagiarized.
Reference images are allowed, but final logo must be unique.
Submit in PNG or JPEG format.
Recommended minimum size is 1000 x 1000 pixels on the given theme.

name: Mehandhi
description: Traditional art competition showcasing creative Mehandhi designs.
event_directives: Apply mehandi on one hand up to the elbow.
Total time allowed is 1 hour.
No phone references or phone usage during the event.
Official mehandi cone will be provided.
Participants must complete within the given time limit.

name: PUBG
event_directives: Team format is Duo only (2 players per team).
Only SCAR-L is allowed; other weapons are prohibited.
Frag and stun grenades are banned.
No restarts for disconnects; teammate must continue.
Hacks, cheats, or glitch abuse lead to immediate disqualification.

name: E-Football
event_directives: Knockout mode with 8-minute matches.
Team form is random; extra time and penalties are enabled.
If match is interrupted, decision follows in-game result screen.
No custom control remapping is allowed.
Unsportsmanlike conduct causes instant disqualification; organizer call is final.

name: Chess
event_directives: Knockout format with 1v1 matches; 3 boards run simultaneously.
Each player gets 15 minutes on the chess clock.
Standard FIDE rules apply; second illegal move means loss.
Draws use tiebreaks: blitz, then Armageddon if needed.
No phones/external help; organizer decisions are final.

name: Photography
event_directives: Individual participation with one camera or smartphone.
Submit exactly one photo.
Only basic editing is allowed.
No AI-generated or pre-taken images are permitted.
Judging is based on composition, creativity, and theme relevance.

name: Videography
description: Create engaging video content showcasing creativity.
event_directives: Theme is announced on day 1.
All footage must be shot during the event window.
Final video duration must be under 3 minutes.
Submit by the announced end-of-day deadline.
Judging is based on storytelling, editing, and theme relevance.

name: Debate
event_directives: Each team has exactly 2 participants: one support and one oppose.
Topic is given at venue with 15 minutes preparation time.
Each team gets 10 minutes to present; warning bell at 9 minutes.
No phones, internet, or external aid during competition.
Judging is based on valid points and presentation; no unparliamentary language.

name: Blind Coding
description: Code without seeing the screen, testing logic and memory.
event_directives: Use only Notepad/basic text editor; IDEs are not allowed.
Monitor must remain off or fully covered while coding.
No internet, AI tools, notes, or pre-written snippets.
After timer ends, submit directly to HackerRank without edits.
Only one compile/run attempt is allowed.
